about: The platform's defaults as AgentMesh publishes them: the reserved system names and, for each, the House Stack's product, read from GET /v1/stack/vocabulary on dev and on production on 2026-10-27 (the two answered byte for byte the same). An architecture job uses this copy only when the platform's defaults are not attached, and says so.

targets.about: Whether the platform's targets enforce an egress allowlist, per environment. Every deploy the AgentMesh deployment manager makes today records egress open, enforced by none (adlc agents/deployment-manager/steps.py EGRESS_OPEN).

systems.name: database
systems.label: Database
systems.purpose: Where an agent keeps what has to outlive a single job.
systems.promises: A store with a document or row door over HTTP. A package reads and writes through the house script and never through a vendor client.
systems.platform_gap: The House Stack has no database for agents yet. An agent that needs one uses a database your organization connects: Supabase or Firestore.

house.label: Not covered yet
house.why: AgentMesh does not run a database for agents.
house.gap: The House Stack has no database for agents yet. An agent that needs one uses a database your organization connects: Supabase or Firestore.

systems.name: files
systems.label: Files
systems.purpose: Where an agent puts pieces and records that outlive a run.
systems.promises: A bucket or folder addressed by key, with read, write and list.
systems.platform_gap: The House Stack has no file store for agents yet. An agent that needs one uses a bucket your organization connects: Google Cloud Storage today.

house.label: Not covered yet
house.why: AgentMesh does not run a file store for agents.
house.gap: The House Stack has no file store for agents yet. An agent that needs one uses a bucket your organization connects: Google Cloud Storage today.
house.swap_note: Amazon S3 can be recorded, but the shared file script cannot sign S3 requests yet.

systems.name: agent-memory
systems.label: Agent memory
systems.purpose: What an agent remembers between jobs: facts it learned, what people told it, and what happened.
systems.promises: Three mesh tools, remember, recall and reflect, over one agent's own memory. An agent reaches only its own memory and never another agent's, and remembering finishes a few seconds after the call returns.

house.label: Hindsight
house.why: An open source memory service (MIT licensed) that keeps what an agent learns and can recall and reflect on it. AgentMesh runs one shared copy with its own database, and each agent reaches only its own memory.
house.swap_note: Nothing else can stand behind agent memory yet. Something else can be recorded, and a deploy then needs it bound by hand.
house.access_words: Reached through a short-lived credential the mesh issues. When an agent is stopped, its access ends within ten minutes, because nothing renews it.

systems.name: sign-in
systems.label: Sign-in
systems.purpose: Who a person is, for an agent that faces people.
systems.promises: An identity provider that returns a verified person and an email, and nothing about what they may do.
systems.platform_gap: The House Stack has no sign-in for agents that face people yet. Connect Okta or Google.

house.label: Not covered yet
house.why: AgentMesh signs its own people in with email links and passkeys, and does not offer that sign-in to agents.
house.gap: The House Stack has no sign-in for agents that face people yet. Connect Okta or Google.

systems.name: mail
systems.label: Mail
systems.purpose: Sending a message to a person by email.
systems.promises: A sender that takes one address, a subject and a body, and reports what happened to it.
systems.platform_gap: The House Stack has no mail sender for agents yet. Connect your own Resend or Amazon SES.

house.label: Not covered yet
house.why: AgentMesh sends its own mail through Resend, and does not lend that sender to agents.
house.gap: The House Stack has no mail sender for agents yet. Connect your own Resend or Amazon SES.

systems.name: text-reasoning
systems.label: Text reasoning
systems.purpose: The model an agent thinks with.
systems.promises: A model provider taking a prompt and returning text, with the model itself a setting.

house.label: AgentMesh's models
house.why: AgentMesh chooses the model and keeps it current. Every harness AgentMesh deploys uses it unless its owner names another model, and the key sits on the machine that deploys it.
house.access_words: Reached with a key placed on the machine the agent runs on. Stopping an agent cuts it off the mesh; this key stays on its machine until it is taken away there.

systems.name: image-reading
systems.label: Image reading
systems.purpose: Reading what is in a picture.
systems.promises: A model provider taking an image and returning text.

house.label: AgentMesh's models
house.why: The same models read images, so one choice covers text and pictures.
house.access_words: Reached with a key placed on the machine the agent runs on. Stopping an agent cuts it off the mesh; this key stays on its machine until it is taken away there.

systems.name: speech-to-text
systems.label: Speech to text
systems.promises: A provider taking audio and returning text.

house.label: AgentMesh's speech recognition
house.why: AgentMesh's own agents already use it for transcripts, so there is nothing to set up.
house.access_words: Reached with a key placed on the machine the agent runs on. Stopping an agent cuts it off the mesh; this key stays on its machine until it is taken away there.

systems.name: text-to-speech
systems.label: Text to speech
systems.promises: A provider taking text and a voice name and returning audio.

house.label: AgentMesh's voices
house.why: AgentMesh's narration uses the same voices, so recordings sound the same across agents.
house.access_words: Reached with a key placed on the machine the agent runs on. Stopping an agent cuts it off the mesh; this key stays on its machine until it is taken away there.

systems.name: api-gateway
systems.label: API gateway
systems.purpose: The door an agent goes through to reach your own services.
systems.promises: One HTTPS base address that fronts a customer's own APIs, with a key in a header. A package calls paths under it and never a service's own address, so the gateway is where the account decides what its agents may reach.

systems.name: mcp-gateway
systems.label: MCP gateway
systems.purpose: Where the MCP servers an agent may use are reached.
systems.promises: One address that fronts an account's MCP servers, with a key. An agent's harness is handed that address for the servers its package declares, instead of each one being typed into every deploy.
systems.platform_gap: The House Stack has no MCP gateway for your own servers yet. Connect your own gateway.

house.label: Not covered yet
house.why: AgentMesh runs an MCP connector for its own tools, and does not offer it as a gateway in front of your MCP servers.
house.gap: The House Stack has no MCP gateway for your own servers yet. Connect your own gateway.

systems.name: draft-host
systems.label: Draft host
systems.purpose: Where a draft is staged for a person to look at before it is published.
systems.promises: A write of one file to an address a person can open, and a read back of what is served.

house.label: Google Cloud Storage
house.why: Each agent writes its drafts into its own private folder in AgentMesh's storage, through a fresh link the mesh issues for each write. An agent that is paused or terminated is refused a new link. The person reviewing a draft opens it with a link the mesh signs, which needs no sign-in and expires after 30 days. Drafts are kept for 90 days.
house.access_words: Reached through a short-lived credential the mesh issues. When an agent is stopped, its access ends within ten minutes, because nothing renews it.

systems.name: activity-record
systems.label: Activity record
systems.purpose: The platform's own record of what an agent did.
systems.promises: An append of one line, by an agent, about its own work. One product, ours.

house.label: NATS JetStream
house.why: The record of what agents did is kept in the same JetStream that carries their messages, so nothing is recorded twice.
house.swap_note: This one is AgentMesh's own record of the network and cannot be swapped.
house.access_words: Carried by the mesh itself, so stopping an agent ends its access at once.

systems.name: calendar
systems.label: Calendar
systems.purpose: Reading and writing a person's appointments.
systems.promises: Not settled. The shape is named when the first package needs it.

systems.name: chat
systems.label: Chat
systems.purpose: Posting into a team's chat, and reading what was said.
systems.promises: Not settled. The shape is named when the first package needs it.

systems.name: payments
systems.label: Payments
systems.purpose: Taking money from a person or an account.
systems.promises: Not settled, and deliberately so. What an agent may charge and who is the merchant is a money decision, not a plumbing one.
